data.title: 庄方宜 · 下班后的茶留给你
data.description: 下班后在街角茶馆碰面，庄方宜仍穿白绿中式原作衣装。她坐在茶桌一侧，轻轻把一杯温茶推到你面前，抬眼微笑；手边的文件已合上，两份小点心摆在中间。
data.action: 将温茶推向镜头，抬眼迎接你
data.mood: 下班后卸下紧绷的温柔
data.promptProse: Zhuang Fangyi sits at one side of the tea-shop table after work, sliding a warm cup toward the viewer with a smile. Preserve her original white-and-celadon top, separate arm sleeves and green trousers in the eye-level medium view. Closed documents lie beside her and two pastries remain at the table center. The far table edge meets a wooden chair back; behind it, a latticed window and a partial screen show the teashop continuing into a quieter seating bay. Soft evening window light catches the cup rim and pale sleeve panels, while the stacked papers and screen recesses retain darker, gently separated shadows.
